headline: BMW Woodruff Plant Operations Supply US Electric iX5 Vehicle Production
summary: BMW's component facility in Woodruff, South Carolina, is supplying battery and hydrogen components for the assembly of the iX5, BMW's first fully electric vehicle assembled in the United States.
why: Automakers are localizing battery and component assembly within North America to optimize EV supply chains and comply with U.S. domestic manufacturing incentives.

impacts.name: BMW
impacts.why: Expanded U.S. manufacturing footprint supports BMW's North American electric vehicle growth.
